olivia.sec: Planning a focused mini-blast drill tomorrow 07:00 PT for private deploys: scope = KMS provider failover (cloud -> local), RBAC scoped rollback, and audit continuity. Need sec + infra.
mark.ops: I'll prep a tiny test cluster and a scoped namespace. We should deny egress by default and allow only vault ns + siem collector.
devon.infra: Netpol snippet I'll apply: default egress deny, allow to namespace with label `role=vault` on 8200 and to SIEM IP on 5044.
olivia.sec: Logging requirements: logs must include `key_id`, `caller_sa`, `action=decrypt`, and `outcome`. Add auditd exec rule for keystore agent.
mark.ops: Rollback approach: apply idempotent RBAC patch that removes cluster-admin from test-sa and grants `keystore:decrypt` role. We'll include a dry-run and a manual approval gate.
devon.infra: We'll run the patched keystore-agent (CVE fixes) but also simulate agent crash as a failure mode to ensure fallback path.
olivia.sec: SIEM check: ship a synthetic decrypt event after rotation and verify it ingests within 45s. If audit events missing or failures spike >5 in 1m, abort.
oncall-bot: Runbook created: keystore-mini-blast-1769992222, assignees: olivia.sec, mark.ops, devon.infra - https://internal/runbooks/keystore-mini-blast-1769992222
mark.ops: Timeline: 06:30 prep, 07:00 start, 07:10 rollback window, 07:30 cleanup. Keep canary output to #eng-security-tests. :thumbsup:
